hero.title: A booking-ready landing page for your workshop studio
hero.subtitle: Publish a multilingual page in minutes, take bookings for your sessions, and keep seats, customers and payments in one place.

create.title: Create your shop
create.body: Sign up, pick your address and languages, and add your contact details.

design.title: Build your page
design.body: Choose a template, edit sections, add your workshops and schedule sessions.

share.title: Share and take bookings
share.body: Publish your page. Guests book a seat and you manage everything from the dashboard.

builder.title: Landing page builder
builder.body: Ready-made templates with sections you can reorder, edit and preview.

booking.title: Seat-safe bookings
booking.body: Session capacity is enforced so a session can never be overbooked.

multilingual.title: Multilingual pages
multilingual.body: Offer your page in English, Vietnamese, Korean and Japanese.

payments.title: Payment tracking
payments.body: Record cash, card and transfer payments and refunds for each booking.

customers.title: Customer list
customers.body: Keep guests and their booking history together.

subdomain.title: Your own address
subdomain.body: Each shop gets its own subdomain for its public page.

cta.title: Ready to fill your next session?
cta.body: Set up your shop in a few minutes.
